## Version step

- [ ] patch (fix, no contract change)
- [ ] minor (new token, component, theme or option)
- [ ] major (renamed or removed class, token, theme or export)

## Checklist

- [ ] I reused existing tokens and components first (CLAUDE.md)
- [ ] `npm test` passes locally
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has a test
- [ ] Visual diffs in `reports/visual/` reviewed before updating baselines
- [ ] Docs page shows every state of anything new
- [ ] Contrast holds in every theme (unit test)
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated
- [ ] No third-party requests added (network test)
